budget.claim: Right-edge yellow column = step budget, shrinks 1/action from 64. Level1 solved in 30, level2 in 26.

goal_full.claim: Win = every yellow covered: pieces on same-orientation targets AND band placed on symmetry axis so piece REFLECTIONS cover flipped yellow targets (level3 won at band row28).

lvl4.claim: Level4 won: two crosses each = U-piece + stem-piece union; pieces placed on one cross and band at symmetry axis made reflections cover the other cross. Band moved 3/press, pieces 3/press.

lvl5.claim: Level5 (2 bands) won by: piece onto its copy + move bands so rot180 copy covers rest; images may spill onto non-yellow -> win = ALL yellow covered, spillover OK.

lvl6.claim: Level6 won (52 presses): pieces can be MULTI-PART single objects (4 disconnected blocks move together); SPACE cycles 4 items (2 bands + 2 pieces); union of 4 images must EXACTLY equal yellow (|T|=4*|piece blocks|).

mirror_pair.claim: Board has a light-blue mirror band; a dark-charcoal piece and its black-with-dots reflection are mirror images about the band. Win = charcoal piece exactly overlaps the yellow target (level1,2 confirmed).

select_cycle.claim: SPACE cycles band->piece1->piece2->band; selected shows WHITE dots; piece on target shows YELLOW dots. Selected object moves 3/press; band moves only perpendicular.

space_toggle.claim: SPACE toggles which is pinned: band-pinned mode -> arrows move BOTH objects +-3 (band fixed, vertical moves work); object-pinned mode -> arrows move band 3 and piece 6 (vertical is no-op). White dots mark the band in band-selected mode.
